svg.title: FIG 4.1: routes from no experience to a first internship offer
svg.desc: A path map. Four routes build proof: a personal hardware project, a student design team, research with a professor, and bench skills in the lab. They join one path: resume, career fairs and referrals, hardware interviews, then a first internship offer. Dashed lines loop back when applications get no interviews, and when a summer falls through.
